articles.title: A crypto pioneer who turned a $20 million family stake into a billion-dollar fund doubles down on bitcoin
articles.snippet: Sourcing initial capital from his mother to build a $1 billion crypto empire, DFG CEO James Wo says market metrics do not support Tom Lee’s $250,000 ether prediction.

articles.title: Are retail traders selling their bitcoin to buy the SpaceX IPO?
articles.snippet: Exchange flows and stablecoin movements through this week's sell-off show no wall of money leaving crypto for cash. Exchanges such as Robinhood and Coinbase will not publicly reporting their figures until July.

articles.title: BlackRock-backed tokenization firm Securitize clears key hurdle to go public on NYSE
articles.snippet: The tokenization specialist behind BlackRock's BUIDL fund could begin trading on the NYSE as SEC approves merger registration.

articles.title: ETH falls to 13-month low on Zcash bug news and Bitcoin drop to sub-$60K: Is $1.4K next?
articles.snippet: ETH price crashed below $1,600 as a vulnerability in Zcash emerged and Bitcoin sold off below $60,000 for the first time in months.

articles.title: Kraken offers SpaceX IPO access through xStocks
articles.snippet: Eligible users in more than 110 markets can register for tokenized SpaceX equity ahead of the company's highly anticipated public listing.
